name: same54
caption:
5-4 AGAIN 🎮🏀 Same start as last season. Except now we have Kawhi.

• 2025-26: 5-4 after 9 games, finished 46-36, 5th seed in the East
• Then Cleveland beat us in 7 games in the first round
• Sept 14, 2026: we trade Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and 5 draft picks for Kawhi Leonard
• 2026-27: 5-4 after 9 games. Kawhi has played 2 of them

Are we better than last year's team? 👇

beats.head: 5-4 AGAIN
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Through nine games, we went five and four. The exact same start as last season. But this time, we have Kawhi Leonard.
beats.dlg: 9 GAMES IN: 5-4.|SAME START AS LAST YEAR.

beats.head: LAST SEASON
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: Last season, that five and four start turned into forty-six wins, the fifth seed, and our first playoff trip since twenty twenty-two.
beats.dlg: LAST YEAR: 46-36,|5TH SEED IN THE EAST.

beats.head: ROUND 1
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: Then Cleveland beat us in seven games in the first round.
beats.dlg: THEN CLEVELAND BEAT US|IN 7 GAMES IN ROUND 1.

beats.head: THE TRADE
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: So we traded Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and five draft picks to bring Kawhi back. He played two of our first nine games.
beats.dlg: INGRAM, DICK + 5 PICKS...|KAWHI: 2 OF OUR FIRST 9.

beats.head: BETTER?
beats.vo: Same start. Are we better than last year's team? Comment below.

facts.claim: 2026-27 game log: game 9, November 6 at Milwaukee, W 121–107, record 5–4

2025-26 game log: game 9, November 7 at Atlanta, W 109–97, record 5–4; finished the regular season 46–36, 5th seed in the Eastern Conference; first playoffs since 2022; lost to the Cleveland Cavaliers in seven games of the first round (round 1, 3–4)
On September 14, 2026, Leonard was traded back to the Raptors in exchange for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and five draft picks
